title: Protocol and Contact
author: Ansel Sandoval
blurb: Yara Dunmore, a whistle-blower living under four names, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. But when a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must trade the one secret worth killing for before the extraction flight leaves at dawn.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
